releases.title: DiRT 3 — TU unlocked, VSync and A limiter variants
releases.notes: # DiRT 3 — TU game-folder variants **Try `Dirt3_TU_vsync60_A.xex` FIRST**, as requested by the contributor. Original release only: Title ID `434D083D`, Media ID `75036F79`, updated executable version `0.0.1.3`. These files are not for the GOTY executable with Media ID `32E5D1A4`. ## Downloads and variants Download `Dirt3_TU_FPS_variants.zip` for all three FPS variants, the clean control, matching `patch.nfs`, installation instructions and verification hashes. XEXs and `patch.nfs` are also separate release assets. - **A — recommended first:** `Dirt3_TU_vsync60_A.xex`, supplied by the contributor unchanged. VSync instruction `39 60 00 01` at file offset `0x6302C0`, plus the guide's second patch `C0 23 04 FC` → `60 00 00 00` at `0x5E2C50`. The second edit is described as a possible game-limiter change; its precise runtime effect is not established by the instruction alone. - **Plain VSync comparison:** `Dirt3_TU_vsync60.xex`, derived from the supplied A by restoring only `C0 23 04 FC` at `0x5E2C50`. All other bytes, including A's container headers, are preserved. This is a comparison build, not a separately supplied console result. - **Unlocked:** `Dirt3_TU_unlocked_gamefolder.xex`, the previously published game-folder build with both guide FPS edits and unlocked presentation; tearing can occur. - **Clean control:** `Dirt3_TU_clean_gamefolder_control.xex`, the previous TU-merged game-folder control without the FPS edits. “vsync60” describes intended synchronized presentation at 60 Hz, not a promise of sustained 60 FPS. ## Installation with patch.nfs 1. Back up your complete extracted DiRT 3 game folder and its original `default.xex`. 2. Extract the ZIP on your PC. These downloads do not include the complete game data. 3. Start with **A**. Copy `Dirt3_TU_vsync60_A.xex` into the complete game folder, rename the selected copy to `default.xex`, and place the supplied **`patch.nfs` in that same folder beside it**. Keep all original game files and subfolders. 4. Launch that `default.xex` through Neighborhood or your usual launcher. Do not put the XEX or `patch.nfs` inside a TU/STFS container; no rebuilt title-update package is supplied. 5. To compare variants, fully exit the game, replace only `default.xex` with the chosen variant, and keep the same matching `patch.nfs` beside it. Use the clean control if investigating a launch failure. 6. After confirming the complete extracted installation works, ISO2GOD Next can convert the full folder directly using its XEX-folder option. Older ISO2GOD versions require a rebuilt ISO. Conversion of this particular set has no separately recorded outcome. The supplied A contains the local `game:` update-data path; it needs the accompanying `patch.nfs`. That file is unchanged from the matching TU: SHA-256 `ab5508f711d2124afb4bd87595043a6f50c1c9d1a5139e8d6492db8b523df0b9`. All 25 compressed data blocks were previously checksum-verified. ## Recorded console history The contributor reports that the original-release unlocked game works. An earlier TU-unlocked build produced “This disc is unreadable”; that historical build is distinct from the local-data game-folder candidates. File comparisons and header inspection establish file contents, not a new console result. Use A first and report behavior for the selected variant.

Keep the matching game/update installation: the TU assets include the merged executable changes, preserve `UPDATE:` paths, and are not a complete update package. releases.title: Bully: Scholarship Edition — unlocked FPS and V-sync files
releases.notes: # Bully: Scholarship Edition — Xbox 360 FPS variants Modified XEX files for an RGH/JTAG Xbox 360, for title `5454081A`, media `0867AD86` (North America). Console testing is reported by the user; FPS was not independently benchmarked in the file audit. | Download | Build | Behavior | | --- | --- | --- | | `Bully_base_unlocked.xex` | Base v1 (`00000001`) | Vsync off; unlocked presentation with possible tearing | | `Bully_TU_unlocked.xex` | Updated v0.0.1.1 (`00000101`) | Vsync off; unlocked presentation with possible tearing | | `Bully_TU_vsync60.xex` | Updated v0.0.1.1 (`00000101`) | Interval 1, intended for vsync at 60 Hz | Choose one matching your game build. Back up `default.xex`, copy the chosen file into the game folder, and rename it to `default.xex`. Keep the backup to restore the original. The updated executables are supplied as complete files; their historical provenance records matching TU package `TU_1A5820Q_0000004000000.0000000000081` merged into the executable. Do not assume compatibility with a different media ID or layer an unrelated TU over them. These patches change frame presentation behavior. Actual FPS depends on the game's workload; “vsync60” does not promise a steady 60 FPS. The audit verified the supplied asset hashes, title/media/version metadata and native images. The updated unlocked/vsync files have identical headers and differ by exactly five bytes: the interval-load instruction and the unlock mask byte. The archive did not include an original executable or TU package, so its original patching and update merge were not independently reproduced. SHA-256 checksums (each XEX is 14,987,264 bytes): ```text 1bbc924b1c8b374c1b97d744af8cc721622f26dd22e9aa042f217833ac1e1416 Bully_base_unlocked.xex ac5f72bd41a64d5ca60b08e6e9e3bd182dd61efe37623456e9814e1f733b72cd Bully_TU_unlocked.xex a9ee087eb3eb6aaa018ae8696bfcf8704cdce1a55b8b81108f577b9bbea6237a Bully_TU_vsync60.xex ``` ## Important: extracted-folder installation only **Bully is not GOD-friendly. Do not convert these modified Bully builds to GOD**, including through ISO2GOD Next. Keep and launch the complete extracted game folder. This game-specific restriction takes precedence over the repository's general GOD conversion instructions.

releases.title: Rainbow Six Vegas 2 — Complete Edition Europe, Streets + VSync + intro skip
releases.notes: # Rainbow Six Vegas 2 — Complete Edition Europe `RSV2_Streets_vsync60_skipall_shortflash.xex` is supplied for **Complete Edition Europe**, Title ID `55530807`, **Media ID `47D7F6C0`**, executable version `0.0.0.6`. It is a different build from the older `1982EE1E` assets in the separate original-edition release; do not interchange them. Contributor-reported features and behavior: - Adds access to the exclusive **Streets** map whose original distribution service was shut down. Use the matching Complete Edition game data; the XEX alone does not supply map assets. - VSync presentation and intro skipping. Startup is reported to fall from approximately **32 seconds to 21 seconds**. - Known downside: the **dark variant of CQC Training reportedly drops to approximately 10–15 FPS during gameplay**. Back up your Complete Edition `default.xex`, copy this variant into that complete extracted game folder and rename the selected copy to `default.xex`. Fully exit and relaunch. Keep the matching game assets. The contributor's feature and timing reports are distinct from the header/hash inspection performed here. `RSV2_Complete_Europe_Streets_intro_skip.zip` packages this XEX with these installation notes and its checksum. The ZIP includes the supplied XEX unchanged, its SHA-256 and installation notes. Its enclosed notes also describe the older builds for context; only the Complete Edition Europe XEX is packaged in this ZIP. ## Variants, pros and cons Both files target Complete Edition Europe: Title ID `55530807`, Media ID `47D7F6C0`, version `0.0.0.6`. Both retain the contributor-reported Streets access and VSync behavior. The absent **Exclusive Content tab** is a menu difference; it does not mean Streets map access is absent. These behavior notes are supplied by the contributor, not inferred from the filenames or header inspection. | Asset | Intro behavior | Pros | Cons / differences | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `RSV2_Streets_vsync60.xex` | No intro skipping; normal intro sequence | Streets access; VSync; keeps the normal startup sequence | No startup-time saving; no Exclusive Content tab; dark CQC Training variant reportedly drops to ~10–15 FPS during gameplay | | `RSV2_Streets_vsync60_skipall_shortflash.xex` | Intro skip with short flash | Streets access; VSync; reported startup ~32 → 21 seconds | Brief startup flash; no Exclusive Content tab; dark CQC Training variant reportedly drops to ~10–15 FPS during gameplay | The Exclusive Content tab and dark CQC Training notes describe the supplied Complete Edition setup; no separate outcome for each exact file hash has been recorded. VSync does not guarantee sustained 60 FPS. Download `RSV2_Complete_Europe_Streets_variants.zip` for both executables, installation notes and hashes. Back up your original `default.xex`, select one variant, copy it into the matching complete extracted game folder and rename the selected copy to `default.xex`. Keep the matching map/game assets and fully restart the game when switching variants. Contributor console observation: dark CQC Training drops to around **10–15 FPS during gameplay**. This is an approximate user-reported range, not a benchmark measured here or an independently established result for both variant hashes.
